2) For rerank: is that 10M tokens already including the context expansion (i.e., the multiplied tokens for candidate passages)?
3) Any max acceptable latency targets for rerank (p95) — helps decide between a larger re-ranker vs a narrow, faster model.

I'll run a quick hosted vs 12mo reserved scenario once I have answers, and attach the initial spreadsheet for transparency. Attaching: BrightLayer_volume_model_mix.xlsx (simple calc)

Marissa — answers below:
1) Embeddings: we track as calls; rough estimate is 333k embedding calls / month (that aligns with ~40M tokens at ~120 tokens per embedding on avg).
2) Rerank: the 10M tokens includes candidate context expansion — so it's the tokenized total going into the re-ranker.
3) Rerank latency target: p95 < 400ms if possible; we can tolerate some degradation during peak but we'd prefer the faster path for user-facing search.

Also to confirm model prefs: for chat we prefer a balance toward quality (customer-facing), so plan for a mid-to-high quality chat model rather than a lower-cost tiny variant. For embeddings, accuracy > cost (for personalization) — so a higher-dim embedding model.

I'll review your spreadsheet and we can sync next week.

— Alex

- Proposed target pricing to present to customer: starting point $50 / 1M tokens (blended) with clear per-model notes; provide a second column with reserved pricing at ~$35 / 1M tokens (assuming 12mo commit and model mix).
